description:
Local and self-hosted platforms (PostgreSQL, Trino, Presto, TimescaleDB, InfluxDB,
Spark, PySpark, DataFusion, SQLite, Polars) currently have no cost tracking.

While these platforms don't have direct per-query cloud costs, tracking execution
metrics enables:
- Resource usage comparison across platforms
- Compute-time-based cost estimation for on-prem infrastructure
- Consistent schema for all platforms in benchmark results

This is lower priority than cloud platform cost estimation since users of local
platforms typically aren't comparing query-level costs.
